duration_drivers: Two routes: one client_config, one provider_adapter
Gemini 2.5 Flash -> Claude Haiku 5.5 is a model change
High token volume needs quota increases first
migration_plan.approach: Config change for the Claude Sonnet 5 Messages route on bedrock-runtime /anthropic, and a Converse adapter that moves the Gemini summarizer to Claude Haiku 5.5.

phases.name: Move traffic
activities: Set AI_PROVIDER=bedrock on one service or environment at a time
Retire the source credentials once stable

step_by_step_guide.dependency_changes: Add aws-bedrock-token-generator>=1,<2 and boto3; keep anthropic; remove google-genai after cutover.

rollback_plan.rollback_time: Immediate: set AI_PROVIDER=source and reload the service
triggers: Response quality below 90% of the source baseline
P95 latency above 2x the source baseline for 5 minutes
Cost per request above 3x the source

alerting_rules.condition: Bedrock error rate above 5% for 2 minutes
Bedrock P95 latency above 3x the source baseline for 5 minutes
alerting_rules.action: Investigate; set AI_PROVIDER=source if it persists

alerting_rules.condition: Response quality below 90% of the source score
Daily Bedrock cost above 2x the projected daily cost
alerting_rules.action: Review token usage and the AWS Budgets alert

alerting_rules.condition: Token usage above 120% of the estimate

production_readiness_checklist: Bedrock model access confirmed for every route
IAM policy attached to the application role
Monitoring and the Bedrock budget active

cost.per_request: within 30% of the source per request

recommendation.approach: Config change for the Claude Sonnet 5 Messages route on bedrock-runtime /anthropic, and a Converse adapter that moves the Gemini summarizer to Claude Haiku 5.5.
key_risks: Quota risk is high for both models: request increases before cutover
gemini-2.5-flash -> Claude Haiku 5.5 changes behavior: compare summaries before moving traffic
Claude bills through AWS Marketplace, so no budget is created until BUDGET_SERVICES names its Cost Explorer services; the planned figure is the high end of a tier range
